startDetails: Starter Core + Steel Guard authored packages compiled by Rust.
The Iron Warden and Warden’s Reckoning form an ordered two-encounter campaign.
adventures.startText: Mara Venn prepares at the Warden's Gate camp.
adventures.title: The Warden's Gate

logDetails: Mara reached zero vitality; no reward or inventory mutation occurred.
Return to camp applies the explicit bounded recovery consequence.
defeat.logText: Mara Venn falls and must recover before continuing.
defeat.summary: No reward was granted; returning to camp applies bounded recovery.
defeat.title: Mara was defeated

introductionDetails: Iron Warden's chain armor and slashing resistance are active sources.
encounters.introductionText: Mara Venn faces the Iron Warden.
encounters.summary: Challenge the armored sentinel guarding the mountain pass.
encounters.title: The Iron Warden

logDetails: Warden chain armor was unequipped and transferred into canonical camp storage.
victory.logText: The Iron Warden falls and yields the Warden chain armor.
victory.summary: Mara prevailed; her remaining vitality and resources carry forward.
victory.title: The Iron Warden defeated

logDetails: No duplicate reward or inventory mutation occurred.
Return to camp applies the explicit bounded recovery consequence.
defeat.logText: Mara withdraws from the final reckoning.
defeat.summary: The authored sequence still completes; camp applies bounded recovery without a reward.
defeat.title: Mara fell at the reckoning

introductionDetails: Rust restores the returning opponent through the bounded vitality track service.
Prior resources, effects, loadout, and the first reward remain authoritative.
encounters.introductionText: The Iron Warden rises for a final reckoning.
encounters.summary: Face the reawakened sentinel after its gate armor has become part of the camp loadout.
encounters.title: The Warden's Reckoning

logDetails: The ordered campaign recorded its second distinct encounter outcome.
The original Warden chain reward remains the only canonical reward instance.
victory.logText: The reawakened sentinel yields and the mountain pass is secure.
victory.summary: Mara completed the authored gate sequence; no duplicate reward was created.
victory.title: The Warden's Reckoning ended
